I'm Tin, a Master of Business Analytics student at Monash University in Melbourne and a Certified Analytics Professional (INFORMS). I finished a Bachelor of Business in Marketing and Business Statistics at Monash in 2025.

For the last three years I've sold wine at Wine Selectors, which taught me how customers decide. I also worked there as a data analyst: I built the daily and weekly sales dashboards the executive team used, and a forecasting model to size a new airport kiosk opportunity. When I presented the results to the General Manager, they changed how the stands were staffed.

I work mostly in R, Python, SQL, Excel and Power BI, and what I care about most is explaining results to people who aren't analysts. This blog is where I practise that, as part of ETC5523 Communicating with Data. In 2020 I led a team to first prize in a competition with a data-driven irrigation prototype for the Mekong Delta.

Away from the screen, I've played guitar for ten years and I play soccer. I speak English and Vietnamese.
